description: This file defines the ElseifBlock class, which is a part of the SCSSPHP compiler source code. The class encapsulates the behavior of an 'elseif' block within the SCSS compilation process, inheriting from a base Block class and setting its type to indicate its role as an 'elseif' condition.

classes.name: ElseifBlock
classes.description: Represents an 'elseif' block in SCSS syntax, used internally within the SCSSPHP compiler to handle conditional logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the block's type to 'elseif' using a constant from the Type class.
